entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, hi. I need to return a VeloBand Pulse. It's not working properly. The heart rate monitor is all over the place.
I understand. I can certainly help you with a return. Can you please provide me with your order number or the email address associated with the purchase?
It's [customer's email address]. And hurry up, I don't have all day!
Thank you. Please give me just a moment while I pull up your order. Okay, I see your purchase of the VeloBand Pulse. Can you confirm the date of purchase for me?
It was, uh... like, 15 days ago. Something like that. I need to get this thing returned ASAP. This VeloBand Pulse is junk.

Okay, I understand your frustration. Let me explain our return policy. At VeloFit, we typically offer a 90-day return policy on most of our products. I see you’re within that timeframe. So you are eligible for a return.
90 days? Great! That's what I wanted to hear. Some companies give you, like, 10 days. That's ridiculous for a smart watch. So what do I need to do?

I apologize for the inconvenience you've experienced with the VeloBand Pulse. To process the return, I will need to generate a prepaid shipping label for you. I will send it to your email address immediately. Simply package the VeloBand Pulse securely and drop it off at any authorized shipping location for that carrier.
And then I get my money back, right?

Yes, once we receive the returned item and verify its condition, a full refund will be issued to your original method of payment. Please allow 7-10 business days for the refund to reflect in your account. If you need to escalate, or have any further questions, please ask for a manager.
Okay, that sounds good. Thanks for making this so easy. I was expecting a huge hassle.
You're very welcome. I'm glad I could assist you. The return label has been sent to [customer's email address]. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
You're very welcome. Have a great day, and thank you for choosing VeloFit!
